reviews.title: Clunky
reviews.text: If you like playing ‘where did they hide the exit button on this pop-up’ every 5 minutes this is the app for you.

reviews.title: Too many ads!!!!
reviews.text: I wish I could give less than one star.  I don’t mind ads while listening.  But podcast app is constantly forcing me to watch ads.  You can’t set a timer or do anything else until the dumb 2 minute ads are finished playing.  Very frustrating.

reviews.title: Adverts I can cope with, sometimes
reviews.text: On the whole the service is ok until the never ending adverts appear and I have to shut the app down and reopen it to get rid of them. Such a waste of time and I guarantee I just put the companies on a list that I will never purchase from. You waste my time, you’re certainly not getting my money.

reviews.title: Free Version is Unusable
reviews.text: Free version has so many ads it’s unusable, paid version is incredibly expensive.

reviews.title: Interruptions

reviews.title: What changed?!?!?!
reviews.text: Loved the app when I started using it a year ago….in the last month something has changed. Some podcast don’t load now…frequently like 3x per week with FOX Headline News.  Less frequently like once per week for my other favorites. What changed?  I am going to different app because of this.

reviews.title: Just Ads
reviews.text: You should put more ads in.  No, really ….ALL the ads. Who cares about the user experience when you can just put in more ads, right?

reviews.title: Ads that cannot be closed
reviews.text: I love this app, listen to it all the time however fullscreen adverts appear, don’t mind that, that cannot be closed no matter how long you wait. The only thing to do is close the app and reopen or click on the advert and it opens an unknown link, which isnt a great security feature. Leaving a 1* review in the hope someone takes notice.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: After viewing an advertisement, it remains on the screen and cannot be removed. And there is no sleep timer using my new iPad mini. Terrible app!

reviews.title: What Happened😫
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for about 3 years and absolutely LOVED it but recently the ads are getting out of control. So many game ads and loading bars where the close button switches and disappears so you have to keep watching. Definitely shifting apps if something doesn’t change soon and I’m sad because I love how you can organize things on this app!

reviews.title: This APP sucks
reviews.text: If you have any sense in your head, do not buy this app!!!  I have to close it and reopen it 3-4 times a day to get my podcasts to download, and they stuff 6-9 mins of what seem like AI generated ads throughout and most of them aren’t even in my area so they’re total useless. I pay for this app so why are you forcing me to listen to your ads???  I will be closing my account as soon as my paid subscription is over. If you charge me, don’t force me to listen to ads also.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Doesn’t indicate that it’s a paid app from the start

reviews.title: Unskippable ads
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for 5 or more years and since the update it crashes and I cannot get anything to play, it just buffers. Also now they have looooong ads and also unskippable ads. It plays an ad that makes you play a game, then forces you to open the App Store then go back to the app where the rest of the ad plays then maybe the episode will play or not. Sometimes you have to close the app out and wait a min. Sometimes it never plays.  Also new episodes don’t work all the time.

reviews.title: Doesn’t really do anything you can get for free

reviews.text: Have had this app for years and every now and then there is a problem with app opening but this time it has gone on for days and I can’t contact app support because it just sits on blue screen app not opening. My only way to get help is hope you app peeps read this. Btw yes my iPhone is up to date and yes plenty of memory available.

reviews.title: When it works, great, but…
reviews.text: While it has a paid tier (but why would someone spend nearly $40 to get it?) it has ad’s, which most you need to close the app to be able to use the app again as you can’t close the ad’s. The other downside to this app is often enough the feeds stop updating so you need to go elsewhere to listen to recent show. So if you’re looking for a  good podcast app, keep looking, this isn’t a good one.

reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.text: Huge selection not a bad app but I don’t enjoy listening for not even a minute to get a ad,, then 5 minutes later another one not even including the ad that was being explained in the podcast. I will not be using this app because i don’t enjoy being ambushed by ads and do not need another monthly payment like every other app

reviews.title: Stop asking for a review
reviews.text: You ask me to rate this app every time I open it, please stop.  I’m resubmitting this because it’s happening again, which is the only reason I’m giving it a 1

reviews.text: The app fails to send a password reset link to email. I’ve checked that my email is typed correctly and it is. I’m not able to access my account. Please fix this ‘glitch.’

reviews.text: I like this app because the UI is solid, but it continues to have periods where other podcast apps are getting new episodes, while this one lags behind, sometimes for full days. If your feed can’t be up to speed with others, I may just have to jump.

reviews.title: My most recent rating is a 1 star.
reviews.text: I love the app and have rated it a 5 star multiple times, but I hate the constant requests that I wrote a review. So, I’m writing a negative review…and will continue to write increasingly negative reviews every time I am bugged about writing a review! Stop it!

reviews.title: Ad Prison
reviews.text: You are forced to watch a “30 second ad“ to access the app, but there’s no way to escape the ad either before 30 seconds or after. You’re still forced to go to the App Store for the ad, then cancel out of that. You’ll spend at least a minute and a half escaping the prison.

reviews.title: Ads don’t close, have to restart app
reviews.text: I’ve really liked this app in the past but the past couple months the number of ads has skyrocketed and they hijack your phone and don’t give you an option to close out of them. The only way to get out of the ad and back to the app itself is to restart the app completely. It’s truly unusable. Scanning other reviews, it seems like many others are having this problem, despite the company saying this is an unexpected occurrence that shouldn’t be happening. If this many people are bringing it up and it hasn’t been addressed I’m interpreting that as a deliberate choice. Will be looking elsewhere.

reviews.title: Adds
reviews.text: Way too many ads some don’t have any place that you can exit out you gotta restart the app. Terrible not buying anything they’re advertising anyway.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: This App is getting more and more irritating.  Far too pushy with trying to force you to sign up and pay.  Making it increasingly difficult to navigate on the phone screen.  If this continues, I’ll be deleting the App…

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: Subscribed to “pro” hoping it would stop the skipped episodes and copious (literally mid-sentence!) ads but it made no difference. Fully updated the app and still have problems. Absolute waste of money.

reviews.title: The Ads stink
reviews.text:
I actually don’t mind that the cheap “twits” weren’t satisfied with our subscriptions, they wanted more money so they started adding annoying full-screen ads that block the podcast screen, including the pause, scroll and other management buttons.

Annoying enough to have to hit the little “X” on the add to get it to reduce so I can manage my podcast - but now some of the ads don’t have a little “X”, or any other means to make them go away so I can get back to managing my podcast.  I finally had to delete the podcast app itself to make it shut up.  

I’ll reload this app and try it again - if I have to delete this app one more time, I’m done.  I’ll look elsewhere.  I think iHeart and others have my same podcasts and aren’t so annoying - next time I’m headed there
